<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="ecc_agent_script_file"><ecc_agent_script_file action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><checksum/><description>Get JSON with Proxmox LXC containers' config</description><directory>false</directory><name>Proxmox_CTs_config.sh</name><parent display_value="SSHScriptFiles">48deb961ff123100ab8fffffffffff07</parent><script>#!/bin/bash

python3 - <<EOF
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def run(cmd: list[str]) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"[warn] Command failed: {' '.join(cmd)}\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
    return result.stdout.strip()


def get_local_node() -> str:
    raw = run(["sudo", "pvesh", "get", "/cluster/status", "--output-format", "json"])
    nodes = json.loads(raw)
    for node in nodes:
        if node.get("local") == 1:
            return node["name"]
    raise RuntimeError("Local node not found in cluster status.")


def get_vmids(node: str) -> list[str]:
    raw = run(["sudo", "pvesh", "get", f"/nodes/{node}/lxc/", "--output-format", "json"])
    containers = json.loads(raw)
    return [str(ct["vmid"]) for ct in containers]


def get_machine_id(vmid: str) -> str:
    tmp_path = Path(f"/tmp/{vmid}.vmid")
    subprocess.run(
        ["sudo", "pct", "pull", vmid, "/etc/machine-id", str(tmp_path)],
        capture_output=True,
    )
    try:
        return Path(tmp_path).read_text().strip()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return ""


def get_config(node: str, vmid: str) -> dict:
    raw = run(["sudo", "pvesh", "get", f"/nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/config", "--output-format", "json"])
    return json.loads(raw)


def main():
    node = get_local_node()
    vmids = get_vmids(node)

    inventory = []
    for vmid in vmids:
        cfg = get_config(node, vmid)
        cfg["machine_id"] = get_machine_id(vmid)
        inventory.append(cfg)

    print(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
</script><script_attachment/><source/><sys_class_name>ecc_agent_script_file</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>karel.benes</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-27 10:16:30</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>eedb5802c30a7610982a7d0ed4013102</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Proxmox_CTs_config.sh</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>ecc_agent_script_file_eedb5802c30a7610982a7d0ed4013102</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>karel.benes</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-03-22 15:59:24</sys_updated_on><use_attachment>false</use_attachment><version/></ecc_agent_script_file></record_update>
